_comment: 30-minute B1 lesson, the first full-length test of the long-form format. Generated by a script, but plain data: edit freely. Narration pacing as on modal_verbs_a1: lists build one item every few seconds ('gap'), quizzes read for 8 s before a 5 s countdown. Build and render: python -m app.lesson reported_speech_b1 --render
title: Reported Speech

lines.text: Sorry, I didn't hear. What did Anna say?

items.bg: Пряка реч: точните думи, в кавички
Непряка реч: предаваме какво е казано

items.sub: tell me · tell him · tell the class
she said that... / she said to me that...

items.en: She **told** her boss she was ill.
items.bg: Каза на шефа си, че е болна.

items.en: He **said** it was a good idea.

pairs.wrong: He told that he was ill.
They told to us a story.

data.heading: Common mistakes

pairs.wrong: She asked where did I live.
He asked me was I OK.
pairs.right: He asked me **if I was** OK.

pairs.wrong: She asked what time is it.

data.title: Commands
data.subtitle: told me to... · asked me not to...

data.heading: Commands and requests
data.example: She **told me not to** be late.

pairs.to: The teacher **told us to** sit down.
She **told me not to** be late.
He **asked me to** close the door.

pairs.wrong: She told me don't be late.
pairs.right: She told me **not to** be late.

pairs.wrong: He asked me close the door.
pairs.right: He asked me **to** close the door.

lines.text: And don't play games all day.
Mum **told me to** tidy my room.
And she **told me not to** play games all day.
